report.interpretation: 512 is the current product ceiling, not an absolute Rust limit. Temporary 1024 and 2048 variants instantiate but exceed the 128-sample/48 kHz budget in these measurements. Use the 256-voice default for additional headroom; physical-browser/device acceptance remains separate. All measured deadline overruns and run variation are retained.

productionValidation.scope: The normalized Relative Turns Span production WASM exactly matches the measured 512-capacity variant.

interpretation: 512 is a chosen product ceiling, not an absolute Rust limit. The final onset-fixed kernel had no deadline overruns in the held 256/512 measurements. The 1024 Frame XY variant had p95 just below the 2.667 ms budget but missed 80 of 1920 blocks; 1024 Relative Turns exceeded the budget in every measured block. The prior 2048 measurements are retained as historical pre-fix evidence and were not rerun. Use the 256-voice default for additional headroom; physical-browser/device acceptance remains separate.

productionValidation.scope: The final white-onset geometry refresh production WASM exactly matches the measured 512-capacity variant.
